record.bible_text: <FO><FO>To the chief Musician<WH05329><WTH8764>, A Psalm<WH04210> of David<WH01732>.<Fo><Fo> In thee, O LORD<WH03068>, do I put my trust<WH02620><WTH8804>; let me never<WH0408><WH05769> be ashamed<WH0954><WTH8799>: deliver<WH06403><WTH8761> me in thy righteousness<WH06666>.

Bow down<WH05186><WTH8685> thine ear<WH0241> to me; deliver<WH05337><WTH8685> me speedily<WH04120>: be thou my strong<WH04581> rock<WH06697>, for an house<WH01004> of defence<WH04686> to save<WH03467><WTH8687> me. <RF>my...: Heb. to me for a rock of strength<Rf>
For thou <FI>art<Fi> my rock<WH05553> and my fortress<WH04686>; therefore for thy name's<WH08034> sake lead<WH05148><WTH8686> me, and guide<WH05095><WTH8762> me.
Pull me out<WH03318><WTH8686> of the net<WH07568> that<WH02098> they have laid privily<WH02934><WTH8804> for me: for thou <FI>art<Fi> my strength<WH04581>.
Into thine hand<WH03027> I commit<WH06485><WTH8686> my spirit<WH07307>: thou hast redeemed<WH06299><WTH8804> me, O LORD<WH03068> God<WH0410> of truth<WH0571>.
I have hated<WH08130><WTH8804> them that regard<WH08104><WTH8802> lying<WH07723> vanities<WH01892>: but I trust<WH0982><WTH8804> in the LORD<WH03068>.

I will be glad<WH01523><WTH8799> and rejoice<WH08055><WTH8799> in thy mercy<WH02617>: for thou hast considered<WH07200><WTH8804> my trouble<WH06040>; thou hast known<WH03045><WTH8804> my soul<WH05315> in adversities<WH06869>;
And hast not shut me up<WH05462><WTH8689> into the hand<WH03027> of the enemy<WH0341><WTH8802>: thou hast set<WH05975><WTH8689> my feet<WH07272> in a large room<WH04800>.<CM>

Have mercy<WH02603><WTH8798> upon me, O LORD<WH03068>, for I am in trouble<WH06887><WTH8804>: mine eye<WH05869> is consumed<WH06244><WTH8804> with grief<WH03708>, <FI>yea<Fi> , my soul<WH05315> and my belly<WH0990>.

For my life<WH02416> is spent<WH03615><WTH8804> with grief<WH03015>, and my years<WH08141> with sighing<WH0585>: my strength<WH03581> faileth<WH03782><WTH8804> because of mine iniquity<WH05771>, and my bones<WH06106> are consumed<WH06244><WTH8804>.

I was a reproach<WH02781> among all mine enemies<WH06887><WTH8802>, but especially<WH03966> among my neighbours<WH07934>, and a fear<WH06343> to mine acquaintance<WH03045><WTH8794>: they that did see<WH07200><WTH8802> me without<WH02351> fled<WH05074><WTH8804> from me.
I am forgotten<WH07911><WTH8738> as a dead man<WH04191><WTH8801> out of mind<WH03820>: I am like a broken<WH06><WTH8802> vessel<WH03627>. <RF>a broken...: Heb. a vessel that perisheth<Rf>

For I have heard<WH08085><WTH8804> the slander<WH01681> of many<WH07227>: fear<WH04032> <FI>was<Fi> on every side<WH05439>: while they took counsel<WH03245><WTH8736> together<WH03162> against me, they devised<WH02161><WTH8804> to take away<WH03947><WTH8800> my life<WH05315>.
But I trusted<WH0982><WTH8804> in thee, O LORD<WH03068>: I said<WH0559><WTH8804>, Thou <FI>art<Fi> my God<WH0430>.
My times<WH06256> <FI>are<Fi> in thy hand<WH03027>: deliver<WH05337><WTH8685> me from the hand<WH03027> of mine enemies<WH0341><WTH8802>, and from them that persecute<WH07291><WTH8802> me.
Make thy face<WH06440> to shine<WH0215><WTH8685> upon thy servant<WH05650>: save<WH03467><WTH8685> me for thy mercies<WH02617>' sake.

Let me not be ashamed<WH0954><WTH8799>, O LORD<WH03068>; for I have called<WH07121><WTH8804> upon thee: let the wicked<WH07563> be ashamed<WH0954><WTH8799>, <FI>and<Fi> let them be silent<WH01826><WTH8799> in the grave<WH07585>. <RF>silent...: or, cut off for<Rf>

Let the lying<WH08267> lips<WH08193> be put to silence<WH0481><WTH8735>; which speak<WH01696><WTH8802> grievous<WH06277> things proudly<WH01346> and contemptuously<WH0937> against the righteous<WH06662>. <RF>grievous...: Heb. a hard thing<Rf><CM>

<FI> Oh<Fi> how great<WH07227> <FI>is<Fi> thy goodness<WH02898>, which thou hast laid up<WH06845><WTH8804> for them that fear<WH03373> thee; <FI>which<Fi> thou hast wrought<WH06466><WTH8804> for them that trust<WH02620><WTH8802> in thee before the sons<WH01121> of men<WH0120>!

Thou shalt hide<WH05641><WTH8686> them in the secret<WH05643> of thy presence<WH06440> from the pride<WH07407> of man<WH0376>: thou shalt keep them secretly<WH06845><WTH8799> in a pavilion<WH05521> from the strife<WH07379> of tongues<WH03956>.
Blessed<WH01288><WTH8803> <FI>be<Fi> the LORD<WH03068>: for he hath shewed me his marvellous<WH06381><WTH8689> kindness<WH02617> in a strong<WH04692> city<WH05892>. <RF>strong: or, fenced<Rf>

For I said<WH0559><WTH8804> in my haste<WH02648><WTH8800>, I am cut off<WH01629><WTH8738> from before<WH05048> thine eyes<WH05869>: nevertheless<WH0403> thou heardest<WH08085><WTH8804> the voice<WH06963> of my supplications<WH08469> when I cried<WH07768><WTH8763> unto thee.

O love<WH0157><WTH8798> the LORD<WH03068>, all ye his saints<WH02623>: <FI>for<Fi> the LORD<WH03068> preserveth<WH05341><WTH8802> the faithful<WH0539><WTH8803>, and plentifully<WH03499> rewardeth<WH07999><WTH8764> the proud<WH01346> doer<WH06213><WTH8802>.
Be of good courage<WH02388><WTH8798>, and he shall strengthen<WH0553><WTH8686> your heart<WH03824>, all ye that hope<WH03176><WTH8764> in the LORD<WH03068>.<CM>
